text: Halving lr delayed formation by only 10-30 steps. Does a dose-response sweep (lr 0.00025, 0.0005, 0.001, 0.002) at N=64, e <= 0.85, seeds 59-61 show formation step scaling as a weak power of 1/lr? That would say whether the window is mostly set by update count (for example warmup or Adam moment statistics) rather than by distance travelled in parameter space.
